Title: New integrated portal for Azure Functions

Body.Content:
Azure Functions has a new portal experience that is more streamlined and more integrated with the rest of the Azure portal. It's now much easier to manage multiple function apps, and there are fewer clicks to get to Azure App Service platform features. 

To learn more, see the blog post.
